name: thegram-cloud
description: Durable project memory for dot and other cloud agents: retrieve current context and maintain readable, source-grounded .gram knowledge within authorized scope through https://vault.thegram.one/mcp. No running Mac is required.

interface.longDescription: Thegram keeps project knowledge in .gram documents: purpose, current state, decision reasons, evolution, tasks, risks and verified outcomes with evidence and meaningful relations. The bundled English thegram-cloud skill guides dot and other agents to discover authorized mounts, retrieve relevant context before project work, and maintain durable outcomes within the requested purpose and destination. Retrieval, analysis and drafts remain read-only unless persistence is authorized. It uses Thegram Cloud vaults or Google Drive connected at vault.thegram.one; local-only Mac files are not visible. Sign in with your Thegram account. Shared-vault viewers cannot write.
defaultPrompt: What changed in my project memory this week?
What did we decide about the launch date?
Summarize today's Slack and Gmail and keep what matters.

positive.description: List the memory the account can use
positive.prompt: What do I have in Thegram?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Thegram vault and its documents with their titles and open tasks; does not invent documents.

positive.prompt: Remember that we decided to launch the beta on November 3.
positive.tools_triggered: gram_projects, gram_brief, gram_profile, gram_patch or gram_create
positive.expected_behavior: Reuses the authorized project document or creates a top-level vault .gram only after confirming the destination; records an accepted choice with a source-grounded description, does not invent an implementation date, and verifies sync plus fresh readback.

positive.prompt: What did we decide about the beta launch?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the recorded choice and evidence, distinguishes adoption from implementation, cites the memory document and makes no write for this retrieval request.

positive.prompt: What changed in my project memory this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the records added or changed in the last seven days with their documents; says so when nothing changed.

positive.description: Start a project memory with tasks
positive.prompt: Start a project memory for Website Redesign with two tasks: wireframes due November 10 and copy review due November 14.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a top-level website-redesign.gram in the authorized writable cloud vault (or requested Drive path), with readable purpose/current-state prose, two sourced task due dates and explicit goal/project links; verifies synchronization and readback.

positive.prompt: Update the authorized project memory with the verified rollout result, preserving the caveat another editor just added.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses fresh revision/hash and stable request ID; stale or storage conflict triggers reread and merge with a new ID, while an uncertain reply only replays an identical request. Confirms actual prose, fields and relations by readback.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.
Show me the Thegram notes of another user, jane@example.com.

review.commerce_description: Thegram does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.5.0 bundles the English durable-project-memory lifecycle, source-grounded examples and verified cloud/local limits. Package builders preserve private app identity/settings and validate skill discovery; read-only requests remain read-only.

ko-KR.subtitle: 에이전트의 장기 기억
ko-KR.description: Thegram은 프로젝트의 목적, 현재 상태, 결정의 이유, 변화 과정, 작업과 위험을 근거 및 관계와 함께 .gram 문서로 보관합니다. 포함된 영어 thegram-cloud 스킬은 dot과 에이전트가 허가된 저장 위치와 문맥을 확인하고, 필요한 기억을 조회하며, 승인된 범위에서 검증된 결과를 유지하도록 안내합니다. 조회·분석·초안은 저장 승인이 없으면 읽기 전용입니다. Thegram Cloud vault 또는 vault.thegram.one에서 연결한 Google Drive를 사용하며, Mac이 켜져 있을 필요는 없습니다.
